news.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45 billion compute deal
news.summary: In August, Nscale and Anthropic announced a $45 billion compute deal. The two companies are reportedly discussing yet another deal of the same magnitude.
news.title_zh: 据报道，Nscale 与 Anthropic 正洽谈另一笔 450 亿美元算力交易
news.summary_zh: 8月，Nscale 与 Anthropic 宣布了一笔 450 亿美元的算力交易；据报道，两家公司正在讨论另一笔同等规模的交易。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 若达成，将进一步凸显头部 AI 实验室对算力的大规模长期承诺，以及算力需求向少数供应商集中的趋势。
news.title_en: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45 billion compute deal
news.summary_en: In August, Nscale and Anthropic announced a $45 billion compute deal. The two companies are reportedly discussing yet another deal of the same magnitude.
news.why_it_matters_en: A second deal of that size would underscore how heavily leading AI labs are committing to compute and how concentrated that demand may become.

news.image_alt: 据报道，Nscale 与 Anthropic 正洽谈另一笔 450 亿美元算力交易

news.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
news.summary: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another. However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman, Hugging Face’s chief policy officer, during a discussio
news.title_zh: Hugging Face 政策负责人：内置 AI 评估器并非易得的解决方案
news.summary_zh: Hugging Face 首席政策官 Irene Solaiman 表示，AI 实验室将声誉押注于模型基准测试，但评估方法复杂且仍在成熟中。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 评估是衡量模型能力与安全性的关键环节；方法尚不成熟，意味着公开基准的结论需要谨慎看待。
news.title_en: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
news.summary_en: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking, but the methods behind evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Hugging Face chief policy officer Irene Solaiman.
news.why_it_matters_en: Evaluations underpin claims about model capability and safety, so their immaturity matters for how much weight benchmarks should carry.

news.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
news.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
news.title_zh: 微软称 AI 智能体类似内部威胁，因为“前沿模型不可信”
news.summary_zh: 微软希望企业密切监控员工在不由 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 实验室控制的系统中使用的智能体。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这反映出企业安全思路正把 AI 智能体视为需要监控和管控的风险来源。
news.title_en: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
news.summary_en: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
news.why_it_matters_en: It signals that enterprises are being urged to treat AI agents as security risks requiring monitoring and controls.

news.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
news.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
news.title_zh: 亚马逊推出 TorchNeuron 开发工具，迄今对英伟达最有力的挑战
news.summary_zh: 亚马逊希望打破英伟达对 PyTorch 的掌控，让更多开发者在包括其自研芯片在内的替代芯片上运行 AI 应用。
news.why_it_matters_zh: PyTorch 是构建大多数 AI 应用的工具包；影响其芯片适配可改变开发者的硬件选择。
news.title_en: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
news.summary_en: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
news.why_it_matters_en: PyTorch is the default toolkit for many AI apps, so shaping how it runs on chips could influence developers’ hardware choices.
news.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified
news.image_alt: 亚马逊推出 TorchNeuron 开发工具，迄今对英伟达最有力的挑战

news.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
news.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
news.title_zh: 黑客攻击 AI 编程工具 OpenCode，导致用户 AI 账户产生费用
news.summary_zh: 开源 AI 编程智能体 OpenCode 的部分在线平台遭入侵，部分用户的 API 密钥被盗，并导致其 AI 账户产生费用；其求助的 AI 工具则拒绝查看恶意代码。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 事件凸显智能体编程工具的安全风险，以及依赖 AI 进行代码安全审查的局限。
news.title_en: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
news.summary_en: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. Hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, running up charges on their AI accounts; the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
news.why_it_matters_en: It highlights the security exposure of agentic coding tools and the limits of relying on AI tools to inspect malicious code.
news.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified
news.image_alt: 黑客攻击 AI 编程工具 OpenCode，导致用户 AI 账户产生费用

news.why_it_matters_zh: 显示 AI 伴侣类消费应用仍能吸引用户和资本。
news.title_en: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
news.summary_en: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

news.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
news.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

news.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
news.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
news.title_zh: 人们正用 AI 让智能电视重新“变笨”
news.summary_zh: 一些智能电视用户厌倦广告、追踪和卡顿界面，正借助 AI 智能体清除预装冗余软件，重新掌控电视。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这反映出消费者对智能电视软件体验的反感，以及 AI 被用于反制厂商预装与追踪。
news.title_en: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
news.summary_en: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
news.why_it_matters_en: It reflects consumer frustration with smart TV software and shows AI being used against bloatware and tracking.

news.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
news.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.
news.title_zh: 英伟达推出新开放模型，用于企业和 PC 上的智能体
news.summary_zh: 英伟达正大力押注企业希望在自己的数据中心运行自有开放模型，并推动设备端私密 AI 智能体。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这表明英伟达在开放权重模型和本地智能体方向上扩展，以适配企业对数据控制的需求。
news.title_en: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
news.summary_en: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows Nvidia expanding into open-weight models and on-device agents as enterprises seek more control over their data.

top5.title_zh: 据报道，Nscale 与 Anthropic 正洽谈另一笔 450 亿美元算力交易
top5.title_en: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45 billion compute deal
top5.what_zh: 8月，Nscale 与 Anthropic 宣布了一笔 450 亿美元的算力交易；据报道，两家公司正在讨论另一笔同等规模的交易。
top5.what_en: In August, Nscale and Anthropic announced a $45 billion compute deal. The two companies are reportedly discussing yet another deal of the same magnitude.
top5.why_zh: 若达成，将进一步凸显头部 AI 实验室对算力的大规模长期承诺，以及算力需求向少数供应商集中的趋势。
top5.why_en: A second deal of that size would underscore how heavily leading AI labs are committing to compute and how concentrated that demand may become.
top5.original_title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45 billion compute deal

top5.title_zh: Hugging Face 政策负责人：内置 AI 评估器并非易得的解决方案
top5.title_en: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
top5.what_zh: Hugging Face 首席政策官 Irene Solaiman 表示，AI 实验室将声誉押注于模型基准测试，但评估方法复杂且仍在成熟中。
top5.what_en: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking, but the methods behind evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Hugging Face chief policy officer Irene Solaiman.
top5.why_zh: 评估是衡量模型能力与安全性的关键环节；方法尚不成熟，意味着公开基准的结论需要谨慎看待。
top5.why_en: Evaluations underpin claims about model capability and safety, so their immaturity matters for how much weight benchmarks should carry.
top5.original_title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says

top5.image_alt: Hugging Face 政策负责人：内置 AI 评估器并非易得的解决方案

top5.title_zh: 微软称 AI 智能体类似内部威胁，因为“前沿模型不可信”
top5.title_en: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
top5.what_zh: 微软希望企业密切监控员工在不由 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 AI 实验室控制的系统中使用的智能体。
top5.what_en: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
top5.why_zh: 这反映出企业安全思路正把 AI 智能体视为需要监控和管控的风险来源。
top5.why_en: It signals that enterprises are being urged to treat AI agents as security risks requiring monitoring and controls.
top5.original_title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’

top5.title_zh: 亚马逊推出 TorchNeuron 开发工具，迄今对英伟达最有力的挑战
top5.title_en: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
top5.what_zh: 亚马逊希望打破英伟达对 PyTorch 的掌控，让更多开发者在包括其自研芯片在内的替代芯片上运行 AI 应用。
top5.what_en: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
top5.why_zh: PyTorch 是构建大多数 AI 应用的工具包；影响其芯片适配可改变开发者的硬件选择。
top5.why_en: PyTorch is the default toolkit for many AI apps, so shaping how it runs on chips could influence developers’ hardware choices.
top5.original_title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool

top5.title_zh: 黑客攻击 AI 编程工具 OpenCode，导致用户 AI 账户产生费用
top5.title_en: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
top5.what_zh: 开源 AI 编程智能体 OpenCode 的部分在线平台遭入侵，部分用户的 API 密钥被盗，并导致其 AI 账户产生费用；其求助的 AI 工具则拒绝查看恶意代码。
top5.what_en: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. Hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, running up charges on their AI accounts; the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
top5.why_zh: 事件凸显智能体编程工具的安全风险，以及依赖 AI 进行代码安全审查的局限。
top5.why_en: It highlights the security exposure of agentic coding tools and the limits of relying on AI tools to inspect malicious code.
top5.original_title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
